business_problem: As Santander expands AI use, manual reviews are not sufficient to continually prove that conversational and agent-based products are reliable, safe, and fair, or to detect behavior changes caused by model updates or changing data.
solution_summary: Santander's Data & AI Science team built a bank-wide evaluation capability for conversational and agent-based AI products. It takes each product's requirements and policies as inputs, generates targeted test cases covering functional behavior and Responsible AI obligations, probes beyond expected cases, and compares results with curated expected behaviors. The framework brings accuracy, performance, behavior, safety, and fairness into one quality view. It runs end-to-end checks before release and repeats evaluations in production to monitor drift, degradation, and emerging vulnerabilities. Its evidence is intended for engineering, product, Responsible AI, and governance teams to assess changes and improve products throughout their lifecycle. The article does not name software products, data-ingestion or storage technologies, or external integrations.
data_flow: Product requirements and policies are used to generate evaluation cases; targeted and exploratory test results are compared with curated expected behaviors. The same evaluation runs before release and in production, where monitoring checks for drift, degradation, and emerging vulnerabilities. Performance, behavior, safety, and fairness are assessed in a shared quality view for engineering, product, Responsible AI, and governance teams.
business_outcome: The capability is intended to help Santander continually assess and improve AI product reliability, safety, and fairness, while identifying drift, degradation, and emerging vulnerabilities across product lifecycles.
architecture_clues: Evaluation cases are generated from each product's requirements and policies.
Curated expected behaviors provide a reference for detecting regressions.
End-to-end pre-release checks are paired with continuous production monitoring.
Accuracy, performance, behavior, safety, and fairness are assessed in one quality view.

source_references.title: When speed meets quality: How we make AI products measurable at Santander

evidence_quotes: The demand was so consistent that the manual review had to become something bigger: a bank-wide capability that checks those Responsible AI concerns automatically, and keeps checking them across a product's whole life rather than once before release.
we built one common way to evaluate AI products across performance, behaviour, safety and fairness.
The same logic runs before and after deployment: an end-to-end quality check ahead of release, and continuous monitoring in production for drift, degradation and emerging vulnerabilities
